scripts.build-web-prod: flutter build web --dart-define=Dart2jsOptimization=00 --dart-define=ENV=prod && yarn clear-web && cp -r build/web/* ../Firebase/public
scripts.build-web-uat: flutter build web --dart-define=Dart2jsOptimization=00 --dart-define=ENV=uat && yarn clear-web && cp -r build/web/* ../Firebase/public
scripts.git-sync: git checkout develop && git pull origin develop && git checkout main && git pull origin main && git checkout claude
